---
name: A chat site broke capture or insert
about: ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini changed its page and Handoff stopped working there
labels: site-adapter
---

**Site:** ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini

**What fails**
- [ ] Capture says "No messages found"
- [ ] Capture misses messages or code blocks
- [ ] Insert doesn't put text in the message box
- [ ] Check can't find the reply

**Date you noticed it:**

**Optional, helps a lot:** in DevTools, right-click a message → Inspect, and paste the opening tag of the
element that wraps one whole message (attributes only, no message text).
